title: cli doesn't seek consent for data collection and terms
body:
The CLI appears to start collecting some usage data merely after installation with npm.

```
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/clause-code
```

The readme has this single line about data collection.
https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code#data-collection-usage-and-retention

Probably needs a consent screen listing all the terms and telemetry details prior to installation and first-use to become compliant in the EU.
author: prabhu
